## Core

### Base Classes

Base classes underlying all models.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [core.CCModel](core.CCModel.qmd#climatecritters.core.CCModel) | The overarching model structure for ClimateCritters. |
| [core.CCOutput](core.CCOutput.qmd#climatecritters.core.CCOutput) | Container for the results of one call to ``CCModel.integrate()``. |
| [core.Forcing](core.Forcing.qmd#climatecritters.core.Forcing) | Unified time-varying signal consumed by models. |

### Forcing

Forcing elements.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [core.forcing.ForcingElement](core.forcing.ForcingElement.qmd#climatecritters.core.forcing.ForcingElement) | A bounded forcing segment backed by an arbitrary callable. |
| [core.forcing.ResolvedSegment](core.forcing.ResolvedSegment.qmd#climatecritters.core.forcing.ResolvedSegment) | Immutable record describing one compiled segment of a `ForcingSequence`. |
| [core.forcing.ForcingSequence](core.forcing.ForcingSequence.qmd#climatecritters.core.forcing.ForcingSequence) | Composable sequence of `ForcingElement` parts. |
| [core.forcing.Hold](core.forcing.Hold.qmd#climatecritters.core.forcing.Hold) | Constant-valued segment. |
| [core.forcing.Ramp](core.forcing.Ramp.qmd#climatecritters.core.forcing.Ramp) | Monotonic transition between two values with linear or cosine easing. |
| [core.forcing.Harmonic](core.forcing.Harmonic.qmd#climatecritters.core.forcing.Harmonic) | Sinusoidal segment with automatic phase continuity. |

## Models

### EBMs

Energy balance models.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [EBMBase](EBMBase.qmd#climatecritters.EBMBase) | Shared energy balance physics for all EBM variants. |
| [EBM0D](EBM0D.qmd#climatecritters.EBM0D) | Zero-dimensional energy balance model for global-mean surface temperature. |
| [EBM1DLat](EBM1DLat.qmd#climatecritters.EBM1DLat) | Diffusive annual-mean latitudinal energy balance model (Budyko-Sellers type). |

### Box Models

Composable framework for building custom multi-reservoir models.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [BoxModelSpec](BoxModelSpec.qmd#climatecritters.BoxModelSpec) | Declarative specification for simple ODE box models. |
| [TwoBoxCarbon](TwoBoxCarbon.qmd#climatecritters.TwoBoxCarbon) | Two-box carbon exchange model with explicit box volumes. |

### Lorenz & Roessler

Single-scale & two-scale Lorenz atmospheric models + Roessler system.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Lorenz63](Lorenz63.qmd#climatecritters.Lorenz63) | Lorenz (1963) system. |
| [Lorenz96](Lorenz96.qmd#climatecritters.Lorenz96) | Lorenz (1996) single-scale and two-scale atmospheric model. |
| [Roessler](Roessler.qmd#climatecritters.Roessler) | Roessler chaotic oscillator. |

### Pendulums & Oscillators

Mechanical oscillators ranging from simple SHM to chaotic driven pendulums.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [SimplePendulum](SimplePendulum.qmd#climatecritters.SimplePendulum) | Nonlinear pendulum with optional linear damping. |
| [DoublePendulum](DoublePendulum.qmd#climatecritters.DoublePendulum) | Double pendulum — a conservative chaotic system. |
| [MultiPendulumBeta](MultiPendulumBeta.qmd#climatecritters.MultiPendulumBeta) | Experimental N-rod chain pendulum solved via a Lagrangian mass matrix. |
| [PendulumRodBeta](PendulumRodBeta.qmd#climatecritters.PendulumRodBeta) | Properties of one rod in a :class:`MultiPendulumBeta` chain. |
| [DampedSpring](DampedSpring.qmd#climatecritters.DampedSpring) | Damped (and optionally driven) spring-mass oscillator. |

### Individual Models

Standalone paleoclimate and dynamical systems models.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [ENSORechargeOscillator](ENSORechargeOscillator.qmd#climatecritters.ENSORechargeOscillator) | Jin-style ENSO recharge oscillator. |
| [Model3](Model3.qmd#climatecritters.Model3) | Model 3 from Ganopolski (2024) describing glacial cycle evolution under orbital forcing. |
| [Stocker2003BipolarSeesaw](Stocker2003BipolarSeesaw.qmd#climatecritters.Stocker2003BipolarSeesaw) | Minimum thermodynamic model for the thermal bipolar seesaw. |
| [Stocker2003ExtendedSeaIceSeesaw](Stocker2003ExtendedSeaIceSeesaw.qmd#climatecritters.Stocker2003ExtendedSeaIceSeesaw) | Extended Stocker-style model with reservoir, Southern Ocean, sea-ice, and Antarctic states. |
| [Stommel](Stommel.qmd#climatecritters.Stommel) | Minimal two-box Stommel thermohaline circulation model. |

## Utils

### Noise

Post-hoc observation noise and stochastic process noise generation.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [utils.noise.from_series](utils.noise.from_series.qmd#climatecritters.utils.noise.from_series) | Generate surrogate series matched to a target Pyleoclim series. |
| [utils.noise.from_param](utils.noise.from_param.qmd#climatecritters.utils.noise.from_param) | Generate surrogate series from a parametric noise model. |

### Resampling

Irregular downsampling utilities for paleoclimate time series.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [utils.resample.downsample](utils.resample.downsample.qmd#climatecritters.utils.resample.downsample) | Downsample a Pyleoclim series by drawing random time increments. |

### Forcing

Factory functions for common Forcing patterns.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [utils.forcing.create_periodic_forcing](utils.forcing.create_periodic_forcing.qmd#climatecritters.utils.forcing.create_periodic_forcing) | Build a composite periodic forcing from normalised sine components. |
| [utils.forcing.create_constant_forcing](utils.forcing.create_constant_forcing.qmd#climatecritters.utils.forcing.create_constant_forcing) | Build a constant forcing. |
| [utils.forcing.create_sinusoid_forcing](utils.forcing.create_sinusoid_forcing.qmd#climatecritters.utils.forcing.create_sinusoid_forcing) | Build a sinusoidal forcing: ``f(t) = y0 + A * sin(2π t / period)``. |
| [utils.forcing.create_piecewise_forcing](utils.forcing.create_piecewise_forcing.qmd#climatecritters.utils.forcing.create_piecewise_forcing) | Build a piecewise forcing from a sequence of :class:`~climatecritters.core.ForcingElement` parts. |

### Solvers

Numerical integration backends and solver helpers.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [utils.solver.Solution](utils.solver.Solution.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.Solution) | Minimal container for the output of a fixed-step integrator. |
| [utils.solver.rk4_method](utils.solver.rk4_method.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.rk4_method) | Fixed-step 4th-order Runge-Kutta integrator. |
| [utils.solver.euler_method](utils.solver.euler_method.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.euler_method) | Fixed-step forward Euler integrator. |
| [utils.solver.euler_maruyama_method](utils.solver.euler_maruyama_method.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.euler_maruyama_method) | Fixed-step Euler-Maruyama integrator for stochastic differential equations. |
| [utils.solver.heun_maruyama_method](utils.solver.heun_maruyama_method.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.heun_maruyama_method) | Fixed-step Heun-Maruyama integrator for stochastic differential equations. |
| [utils.solver.milstein_method](utils.solver.milstein_method.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.milstein_method) | Fixed-step Milstein integrator for stochastic differential equations. |
| [utils.solver.define_t_eval](utils.solver.define_t_eval.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.define_t_eval) | Build a ``t_eval`` array for use with :func:`scipy.integrate.solve_ivp`. |
| [utils.solver.validate_monotonic_grid](utils.solver.validate_monotonic_grid.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.validate_monotonic_grid) | Validate a strictly increasing 1-D coordinate array. |
| [utils.solver.validate_layer_thicknesses](utils.solver.validate_layer_thicknesses.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.validate_layer_thicknesses) | Validate positive layer thicknesses. |
| [utils.solver.flux_divergence](utils.solver.flux_divergence.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.flux_divergence) | Compute finite-volume tendency from face fluxes and layer thicknesses. |
| [utils.solver.validate_initial_state](utils.solver.validate_initial_state.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.validate_initial_state) | Validate and normalize the initial state vector. |
| [utils.solver.build_state_from_history](utils.solver.build_state_from_history.qmd#climatecritters.utils.solver.build_state_from_history) | Build a structured state array from a solved trajectory. |

### Functions

Signal processing and interpolation utilities.


| | |
| --- | --- |
| [utils.func.make_derivative_func](utils.func.make_derivative_func.qmd#climatecritters.utils.func.make_derivative_func) | Return a callable that evaluates the derivative of a forcing at arbitrary times. |
| [utils.func.smooth_and_interpolate](utils.func.smooth_and_interpolate.qmd#climatecritters.utils.func.smooth_and_interpolate) | Apply a centered moving-average and interpolate onto a target time axis. |
